Portability release: Cadence works with any agent harness, reads the room on Linux, learns which nudges you push back on, and knows a meeting is coming. (Folds in the staged-but-unshipped v0.2.1: Codex surface, machine-load dial, expanded intent detection, autonomous git flow.)

**`cadence envelope` — use Cadence with any agent**
One blessed primitive: run `cadence envelope` in any harness's pre-prompt hook and prepend its stdout. Empty output means inject nothing; `--json` gives the structured form. The Claude Code hooks and MCP server are now just two consumers of the same contract — your custom agent can be the third.

**Linux reads the room**
Music arrives via MPRIS (`playerctl` — Spotify and most players), battery via `/sys/class/power_supply`. Both degrade silently when unavailable, and CI now runs the full suite on Linux and macOS to keep that contract tested. "macOS-only alpha" is retired: richest signals on macOS, universal signals everywhere.

**Calendar (opt-in): wrap-up pressure**
`cadence calendar set-url <ics-url>` (a secret Google/Outlook ICS link) and Cadence sees "next event in 12m" — pace and posture rise when something's imminent; tone and proactivity stay yours. Minutes-only by default; event titles are a separate opt-in (`cadence calendar titles on`). Recurring events are skipped in v1.

**Per-project pins**
"Always terse in this repo, ask-first in prod infra": `cadence set <dial> <level> --project` pins a dial for the current directory tree only. Pins live in your `~/.cadence/config.json`, never in repo files — a cloned repo can't grant itself authority. `cadence projects` lists them; precedence is global → project → env var.

**The learning loop closes**
With tuning enabled (`cadence enable tuning`), `cadence tune` now attributes pushback to the exact rule that nudged: "env.late fired 23×, pushback followed 39% of the time vs 13% baseline — consider softening." Flags require real sample sizes and beat-the-baseline honesty, so a grumpy week indicts nothing. Report-only: Cadence suggests pins, never applies them. New `/cadence:tune` skill interprets the report in plain English.

**Codex surface** *(staged in v0.2.1, ships now)*
`.codex-plugin/` rides along in the package — same signals, same dials, delivered as an invocable skill rather than automatic prompt injection.

**Smaller but real** *(v0.2.1 items now shipping)*
- Machine load moves the dials: busy CPU → pace=fast, posture=decisive
- More developer moments auto-detected: code review, "get this done", "walk me through…"
- Git flow is fully autonomous: 3+ commits/hr raises proactivity too; conflict still overrides
- Session greeting no longer says "hasn't heard from you" while music plays
- Skills tightened: explicit-invocation-only everywhere, `cadence envelope` under the shared skill, setup offers calendar/tuning/project pins, paused never reads as broken
- `cadence unset all` no longer wipes providers/location/projects from config

187 tests, 0 failures, verified on ubuntu + macOS.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cullumco/cadence
